Video Editing & Motion Graphics

I edit short-form video for social: reels, clips cut from long recordings, and brand videos. I cut for pace, add captions and sound, and build motion graphics in the client’s fonts and colors. Edited with Claude, in Premiere Pro and CapCut.

Graphic Design

Carousels, quote posts, banners, and event graphics. I work from each client’s brand guidelines and design every carousel so the first slide earns the swipe and the last one gives a clear next step. Designed in Photoshop and Illustrator.

The same work usually takes a designer about a week.

I designed each of these lead magnets in about three hours using an AI workflow I built. For TimeForge that means a new 12 to 20 page lead magnet in an afternoon instead of a week of design time.

Paid media

How I Approach Paid Media

Before I make an ad I look at three numbers: what it costs to win a customer, what that customer is worth over time, and how many leave. They tell me how much the business can afford to spend and what is worth testing first.

An ad only works if the rest of the path keeps its promise, so I check the landing page, the sales process, and what happens after the purchase before I write the script.

I’ve built AI workflows that analyze competitor ads at scale, from 250 to 1,000 ads at a time. They show which hooks, angles, and value propositions keep winning and how saturated the market is, so I can write a message that already works for the category and add a value proposition the competitors don’t offer.

I completed Platzi’s Meta Ads and Paid Campaigns for Marketing courses in 2026.

08About Me

One question keeps me curious: why do people buy?

I’m David Valencia, a creative strategist and AI ad producer from El Salvador. I’m always looking for ways to get better, whether that means sharpening my craft, deepening my education, or growing as a person.

I want to know what makes someone stop and pay attention, what makes an offer feel relevant, and what gives them enough confidence to buy.

I completed a six-month program at Instituto de Comunicación and graduated in Barcelona, Spain, in April 2026. Its founder, Adrià Solà Pastor, has worked as a communication coach with international brands like Amazon, Notion, Binance, LinkedIn, and Hostinger, and gave the most-viewed Spanish-language TEDx talk of 2025. The program taught me to communicate more clearly, to listen actively, to make a message land, and to adapt a sales message to different audiences.

When I develop an ad, I start with what the customer cares about. That insight shapes the hook, the script, and what I choose to show on screen.
